sentences.en: BELLA: Hi Don - did you get the copy of the article on recycling footwear that I emailed you?
sentences.zh: BELLA: 嗨，唐，你收到我邮件发给你的那篇关于回收鞋类的文章了吗？

sentences.en: DON: Yeah - it's here I've had a look at it.
sentences.zh: DON: 嗯，收到了，我已看过。

sentences.en: BELLA: So do you think it's a good topic for our presentation?
sentences.zh: BELLA: 那你觉得这个话题适合作为我们的演讲主题吗？

sentences.en: DON: Well, before I started reading it, I thought recycling footwear, well, although it's quite interesting, perhaps there isn't enough to say about it, cos we put shoes in recycling bins, they go to charity shops and that's about it.
sentences.zh: DON: 嗯，在开始阅读之前，我以为回收鞋类虽然挺有意思，但可能没什么可讲的，因为我们把鞋子放进回收箱后，它们就送到慈善商店了，仅此而已。

sentences.en: BELLA: but there's much more to it than that.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 但其实远不止这些。

sentences.en: DON: I realise that now and I'm keen to research the topic more.
sentences.zh: DON: 我现在意识到了这一点，而且很想进一步研究这个课题。

sentences.en: BELLA: That's great.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 太好了。

sentences.en: DON: One of the things I didn't realise until I read the article was just how many pairs of trainers get recycled!
sentences.zh: DON: 我直到读了这篇文章才意识到，原来有如此多双运动鞋被回收！

sentences.en: BELLA: Well, a lot a of young people wear them all the time now.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 嗯，现在很多年轻人一直穿着运动鞋。

sentences.en: They've become more popular than ordinary shoes.
sentences.zh: 运动鞋已比普通鞋子更受欢迎。

sentences.en: DON: know. guess they are very hard-wearing, but don't they look a bit casual for school uniform?
sentences.zh: DON: 是啊。我想它们确实非常耐穿，但穿校服时穿运动鞋会不会显得太随意了？

sentences.en: I don't think they're right for that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这不太合适。

sentences.en: BELLA: Actually, I think some of them look quite smart on pupils .. better than a scruffy old pair of shoes.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 实际上，我觉得有些运动鞋穿在学生身上还挺帅气的……比一双破旧邋遢的普通鞋子强多了。

sentences.en: So do you keep shoes a long time?
sentences.zh: 那你会长期保留鞋子吗？

sentences.en: DON: Yes.
sentences.zh: DON: 是的。

sentences.en: Though I do tend to wear my old pairs for doing dirty jobs like cleaning my bike.
sentences.zh: 不过我通常会把旧鞋子留着干脏活，比如清洗我的自行车。

sentences.en: BELLA: must admit, I've recycled some perfectly good shoes, that haven't gone out of fashion and still fit, just because they don't look great on me any more.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 我得承认，我曾把一些状况极好、既没过时也没不合脚的鞋子给回收了，仅仅因为它们穿在我身上不再好看。

sentences.en: That's awful isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这不是很糟糕吗？

sentences.en: DON: think it's common because there's sO much choice.
sentences.zh: DON: 我觉得这种情况很普遍，因为可选的款式实在太多了。

sentences.en: The article did say that recent sales of footwear have increased enormously.
sentences.zh: 文章中提到，近期鞋类销量大幅增长。

sentences.en: BELLA: That didn't surprise me.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 这一点倒没让我感到意外。

sentences.en: DON: No.
sentences.zh: DON: 是啊。

sentences.en: But then it said that the amount of recycled footwear has fallen: it's 6 percent now compared to a previous level of 11 percent.
sentences.zh: 但接着文章又指出，被回收的鞋类数量却下降了：目前仅为6%，而此前为11%。

sentences.en: That doesn't seem to make sense.
sentences.zh: 这似乎说不通啊。

sentences.en: BELLA: That's because not everything goes through the recycling process.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 这是因为并非所有鞋类都会进入回收流程。

sentences.en: Some footwear just isn't good enough to re-sell, for one reason or another, and gets rejected.
sentences.zh: 由于种种原因，部分鞋类质量不够好，无法再次销售，因而被拒收。

sentences.en: BELLA: So let's find some examples in the article of footwear that was rejected for recycling.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 那我们就在文章中找些被拒收的鞋类实例吧。

sentences.en: DON: OK.
sentences.zh: DON: 好的。

sentences.en: I think there are some in the interview with the recycling manager.
sentences.zh: 我想在采访回收经理的部分里有一些例子。

sentences.en: Yeah - here it is.
sentences.zh: 对——就在这里。

sentences.en: BELLA: Mmm.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 嗯。

sentences.en: Let's start with the ladies' high-heeled shoes.
sentences.zh: 我们先从女士高跟鞋说起吧。

sentences.en: What did he say about those?
sentences.zh: 他对这些鞋是怎么说的？

sentences.en: DON: He said they were probably expensive - the material was suede and they were beige in colour - it looked like someone had only worn them once, but in a very wet field SO the heels were too stained with mud and grass to re-sell them.
sentences.zh: DON: 他说这些鞋可能价格不菲——材质是绒面革，颜色为米色——看起来好像只穿过一次，但曾在非常潮湿的田野里穿过，因此鞋跟沾染了太多泥巴和草渍，无法再次销售。

sentences.en: BELLA: OK . . . and the leather ankle boots.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 好的……那皮质短靴呢？

sentences.en: What was wrong with them?
sentences.zh: 它们有什么问题？

sentences.en: DON: Apparently, the heels were worn but that wasn't the problem.
sentences.zh: DON: 据说鞋跟虽已磨损，但这并非主要问题。

sentences.en: One of the shoes was a much lighter shade than the other one - it had obviously been left in the sun.
sentences.zh: 其中一只鞋的颜色明显比另一只浅得多——显然是长期暴露在阳光下所致。

sentences.en: I suppose even second-hand shoes should look the same!
sentences.zh: 我想即便是二手鞋，也应该看起来一致吧！

sentences.en: BELLA: Sure.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 当然。

sentences.en: Then there were the red baby shoes.
sentences.zh: 然后是那双红色的婴儿鞋。

sentences.en: DON: Oh yes - we're told to tie shoes together when we put them in a recycling bin, but people often don't bother.
sentences.zh: DON: 哦，对——我们被告知，把鞋子放进回收箱时应将两只鞋系在一起，但人们常常懒得这么做。

sentences.en: BELLA: You'd think it would have been easy to find the other, but it wasn't.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 你本以为找到另一只应该很容易，但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: That was a shame because they were obviously new.
sentences.zh: 那真可惜，因为它们显然还是全新的。

sentences.en: DON: The trainers were interesting.
sentences.zh: DON: 那些运动鞋很有意思。

sentences.en: He said they looked like they'd been worn by a marathon runner.
sentences.zh: 他说它们看起来像是被马拉松跑者穿过的。

sentences.en: BELLA: Yeah - weren't they split?
sentences.zh: BELLA: 是啊——它们不是裂开了吗？

sentences.en: DON: Not exactly.
sentences.zh: DON: 并不完全是。

sentences.en: One of the soles was so worn under the foot that you could put your.
sentences.zh: 其中一只鞋底脚掌部位磨损得极其严重，以至于你能用手指直接戳穿它。

sentences.en: finger through it.
sentences.zh: 你的手指能直接穿过它。

sentences.en: Well, we could certainly use some of those examples in our presentation to explain why 90 percent of shoes that people take to recycling centres or bins get thrown into landfill.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们当然可以在演示中使用其中一些例子，来解释为何送至回收中心或回收箱的鞋子中有90%最终被填埋处理。

sentences.en: BELLA: Mmm.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 嗯。

sentences.en: What did you think about the project his team set up to avoid this by making new shoes out of the good parts of old shoes?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他所在团队为避免这种情况而发起的项目如何？该项目旨在利用旧鞋上完好的部件制作新鞋。

sentences.en: DON: It sounded like a good idea.
sentences.zh: DON: 听起来是个好主意。

sentences.en: They get so many shoes, they should be able to match parts.
sentences.zh: 他们收到的鞋子数量如此之多，理应能成功匹配各部件。

sentences.en: I wasn't surprised that it failed, though. mean who wants to buy second-hand shoes really?
sentences.zh: 不过，我并不惊讶这个项目最终失败了。我的意思是，谁真的想买二手鞋呢？

sentences.en: Think of all the germs you could catch!
sentences.zh: 想想你可能沾染的所有细菌吧！

sentences.en: BELLA: Well, people didn't refuse them for that reason, did they?
sentences.zh: BELLA: 嗯，人们拒绝这些鞋并不是出于这个原因，对吧？

sentences.en: It was because the pairs of shoes weren't identical.
sentences.zh: 真正原因是成对的鞋子并不完全相同。

sentences.en: DON: They still managed to ship them overseas, though.
sentences.zh: DON: 不过，他们最终还是把这些鞋运往海外了。

sentences.en: BELLA: That's another area we need to discuss.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 这是我们需要讨论的另一个方面。

sentences.en: DON: You know I used to consider this topic just from my own perspective, by thinking about my own recycling behaviour without looking at the bigger picture.
sentences.zh: DON: 你知道，我过去仅从自身角度考虑这一话题，只思考自己的回收行为，而未顾及更宏观的图景。

sentences.en: So much happens once shoes leave the recycling area.
sentences.zh: 鞋子一旦离开回收区域，后续会发生太多事情。

sentences.en: BELLA: It's not as simple as you first think, and we can show that by taking a very different approach to it.
sentences.zh: BELLA: 这远不像你最初想象的那么简单，而我们可以通过一种截然不同的方法来展现这一点。

sentences.en: DON: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: DON: 没错。

sentences.en: So let's discuss . . .
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们来讨论……
